results.question: Employees per company via profiles join.
results.answer:

### If `profiles` has `company_id`
```sql
SELECT
  c.company_id,
  c.company_name,
  COUNT(p.profile_id) AS employee_count
FROM companies c
JOIN profiles p
  ON p.company_id = c.company_id
GROUP BY
  c.company_id, c.company_name
ORDER BY employee_count DESC;
```

### If `profiles` has `company_id` but you only need the company name
```sql
SELECT
  c.company_name,
  COUNT(*) AS employee_count
FROM companies c
JOIN profiles p
  ON p.company_id = c.company_id
GROUP BY c.company_name
ORDER BY employee_count DESC;
```

### If you want to include companies with zero employees (LEFT JOIN)
```sql
SELECT
  c.company_id,
  c.company_name,
  COUNT(p.profile_id) AS employee_count
FROM companies c
LEFT JOIN profiles p
  ON p.company_id = c.company_id
GROUP BY
  c.company_id, c.company_name
ORDER BY employee_count DESC;
```

SELECT "mcu_results"."Id" AS "McuResultId",
       "mcu_registrations"."Id" AS "McuRegistrationId",
       "mcu_registrations"."ParticipantId" AS "ParticipantId",
       "participants"."FullName" AS "ParticipantName",
       "mcu_registrations"."Status" AS "RegistrationStatus",
       "mcu_results"."AttemptNo" AS "AttemptNo",
       "mcu_results"."ResultStatus" AS "ResultStatus",
       "mcu_results"."FitWithGlasses" AS "FitWithGlasses",
       "mcu_results"."ResultDate" AS "ResultDate",
       "mcu_results"."NextMcuDate" AS "NextMcuDate"
FROM "mcu_results"
JOIN "mcu_registrations"
  ON "mcu_results"."McuRegistrationId" = "mcu_registrations"."Id"
JOIN "participants"
  ON "mcu_registrations"."ParticipantId" = "participants"."Id"

SELECT p."Id" AS "ParticipantId",
       p."FullName" AS "ParticipantName",

1. **Alat Pelindung Diri (APD) minimum yang wajib dipakai setiap orang saat memasuki area operasional tambang adalah...**  
   **Jawaban benar:** Helm safety, sepatu safety, dan rompi/vest reflektif

2. **Warna rambu K3 yang menandakan LARANGAN... adalah...**  
   **Jawaban benar:** Merah dengan lingkaran dan garis diagonal

3. **Warna rambu K3 yang menandakan PERINGATAN/AWAS bahaya... adalah...**  
   **Jawaban benar:** Kuning dengan simbol/tulisan hitam

4. **Warna rambu K3 yang menandakan KEWAJIBAN... adalah...**  
   **Jawaban benar:** Biru dengan simbol putih

5. **Apa yang harus dilakukan saat mendengar sirine tanda keadaan darurat (emergency alarm) di area tambang?**  
   **Jawaban benar:** Berhenti bekerja, ikuti prosedur evakuasi, dan menuju titik kumpul (assembly point) terdekat

6. **Fungsi utama Danger Tag / Isolation Tag (LOTO - Lock Out Tag Out) pada peralatan adalah...**  
   **Jawaban benar:** Menandai bahwa alat sedang dalam perbaikan/isolasi dan TIDAK BOLEH dioperasikan sampai tag dilepas oleh yang berwenang

7. **Siapa yang berwenang melepas Danger Tag/Isolation Tag dari suatu peralatan?**  
   **Jawaban benar:** Orang/petugas yang memasang tag tersebut (atau yang berwenang sesuai prosedur isolasi)

8. **Saat berjalan kaki di area tambang yang dilalui unit alat berat... yang harus diperhatikan pekerja adalah...**  
   **Jawaban benar:** Menjaga jarak aman, memastikan kontak mata dengan operator, dan menghindari blind spot (titik buta) alat berat

9. **Batas kecepatan kendaraan ringan (light vehicle) di area tambang umumnya...**  
   **Jawaban benar:** Mengikuti rambu batas kecepatan setempat dan wajib disesuaikan dengan kondisi jalan/cuaca

10. **Apa yang harus dilakukan pekerja jika menemukan kondisi tidak aman (unsafe condition) atau nyaris celaka (near miss)?**  
   **Jawaban benar:** Melaporkan ke atasan/pengawas/HSE sesegera mungkin sesuai prosedur pelaporan

11. **Merokok di area tambang hanya diperbolehkan di...**  
   **Jawaban benar:** Smoking area/area yang telah ditentukan dan diberi tanda khusus

12. **Penggunaan alkohol dan/atau narkoba oleh pekerja di area tambang adalah...**  
   **Jawaban benar:** Dilarang keras (zero tolerance) baik saat bekerja maupun berada di area tambang

13. **Hierarki pengendalian bahaya (hierarchy of control) yang paling diutamakan/paling efektif adalah...**  
   **Jawaban benar:** Eliminasi bahaya (menghilangkan sumber bahaya sepenuhnya)

14. **APD tambahan yang wajib digunakan saat bekerja di ketinggian (working at height) adalah...**  
   **Jawaban benar:** Full body harness dengan lanyard yang terpasang pada titik angkur (anchor point) yang sesuai

15. **SIMPER (Surat Izin Mengemudi/Mengoperasikan Peralatan) berfungsi sebagai...**  
   **Jawaban benar:** Bukti kompetensi dan izin resmi bagi seseorang untuk mengoperasikan unit/kendaraan tertentu di area tambang

16. **Apa yang wajib dilakukan sebelum mengoperasikan unit/alat berat di awal shift?**  
   **Jawaban benar:** Melakukan pemeriksaan P2H (Pemeriksaan sebelum digunakan/pre-use inspection) sesuai checklist

17. **Tindakan pertama yang tepat saat terjadi cuaca ekstrem seperti petir (lightning) di area tambang adalah...**  
   **Jawaban benar:** Menghentikan aktivitas berisiko, mencari perlindungan aman, dan mengikuti prosedur cuaca ekstrem/lightning warning setempat

18. **Prinsip housekeeping (5R/5S) di tempat kerja bertujuan untuk...**  
   **Jawaban benar:** Menjaga area kerja tetap rapi, bersih, tertata, dan aman sehingga mengurangi risiko kecelakaan

19. **Jika pekerja merasa lelah/mengantuk (fatigue) saat bertugas, tindakan yang benar adalah...**  
   **Jawaban benar:** Melaporkan kondisi ke pengawas dan beristirahat sesuai prosedur manajemen kelelahan (fatigue management)

20. **Komunikasi radio di area tambang penting terutama untuk...**

SELECT
  p."Id" AS "ParticipantId",
  p."FullName" AS "ParticipantName",
  p."ParticipantType" AS "ParticipantType",
  ib."Id" AS "InductionBatchId",
  ib."BatchNo" AS "BatchNo",
  ib."Status" AS "BatchStatus",
  ib."StartDate" AS "BatchStartDate",
  s."Id" AS "SiteId",
  s."Name" AS "SiteName",
  it."Id" AS "InductionTypeId",
  it."Code" AS "InductionTypeCode",
  it."Name" AS "InductionTypeName",
  COUNT(DISTINCT ipm."ModuleId") FILTER (WHERE ipm."ExamStatus" = 'PASSED') AS "PassedModulesCount",
  COUNT(DISTINCT ipm."ModuleId") AS "TotalModulesCount"
FROM "induction_participants" ip
JOIN "participants" p ON p."Id" = ip."ParticipantId"
JOIN "induction_batches" ib ON ib."Id" = ip."BatchId"
JOIN "sites" s ON s."Id" = ib."SiteId"
JOIN "induction_types" it ON it."Id" = ib."InductionTypeId"
JOIN "induction_participant_modules" ipm ON ipm."InductionParticipantId" = ip."Id"
WHERE ip."IsDeleted" = false
  AND ipm."IsDeleted" = false
  AND ib."IsDeleted" = false
  AND s."IsDeleted" = false
  AND it."IsDeleted" = false
GROUP BY
  p."Id", p."FullName", p."ParticipantType",
  ib."Id", ib."BatchNo", ib."Status", ib."StartDate",
  s."Id", s."Name",
  it."Id", it."Code", it."Name"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ipm."ModuleId") > 0
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT ipm."ModuleId") = COUNT(DISTINCT ipm."ModuleId") FILTER (WHERE ipm."ExamStatus" = 'PASSED')
ORDER BY ib."StartDate" DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
  "s"."Id" AS "SiteId",
  "s"."Code" AS "SiteCode",
  "s"."Name" AS "SiteName",
  COUNT(DISTINCT "ib"."Id") AS "InductionBatchesCount",
  COUNT(DISTINCT "tb"."Id") AS "TrainingBatchesCount",
  COUNT(DISTINCT "ib"."Id") FILTER (
    WHERE "tb"."Id" IS NOT NULL
  ) AS "InductionBatchesWithOverlappingTraining"
FROM "sites" "s"
LEFT JOIN "induction_batches" "ib"
  ON "ib"."SiteId" = "s"."Id"
  AND "ib"."IsDeleted" = false
LEFT JOIN "training_batches" "tb"
  ON "tb"."SiteId" = "s"."Id"
  AND "tb"."IsDeleted" = false
  AND "ib"."StartDate"::timestamp with time zone <= "tb"."EndDate"
  AND "ib"."StartDate"::timestamp with time zone >= "tb"."StartDate"
GROUP BY
  "s"."Id", "s"."Code", "s"."Name"
ORDER BY "InductionBatchesWithOverlappingTraining" DESC, "InductionBatchesCount" DESC
LIMIT 100;

  AND "tb"."SiteId" = "s"."Id"

GROUP BY "s"."Id", "s"."Code", "s"."Name"
ORDER BY "s"."Name" ASC

WITH pax_per_site AS (
  SELECT
    p."SiteId" AS "SiteId",
    COUNT(*) AS "TotalPax"
  FROM "participants" p
  GROUP BY p."SiteId"
),
active_permits_per_site AS (
  SELECT
    p."SiteId" AS "SiteId",
    COUNT(*) AS "ActivePermits"
  FROM "permits" pr
  JOIN "participants" p ON p."Id" = pr."ParticipantId"
  WHERE pr."Status" = 'ACTIVE'
  GROUP BY p."SiteId"
),
fit_mcu_per_site AS (
  SELECT
    p."SiteId" AS "SiteId",
    COUNT(*) AS "FitMcuCount"
  FROM "mcu_results" mr
  JOIN "mcu_registrations" r ON r."Id" = mr."McuRegistrationId"
  JOIN "participants" p ON p."Id" = r."ParticipantId"
  WHERE mr."ResultStatus" = 'FIT'
  GROUP BY p."SiteId"
),
passed_training_per_site AS (
  SELECT
    p."SiteId" AS "SiteId",
    COUNT(*) AS "PassedTrainingCount"
  FROM "training_participants" tp
  JOIN "participants" p ON p."Id" = tp."ParticipantId"
  WHERE tp."PassedAt" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p."SiteId"
)
SELECT
  s."Id" AS "SiteId",
  s."Name" AS "SiteName",
  COALESCE(ap."ActivePermits", 0) + COALESCE(fm."FitMcuCount", 0) + COALESCE(pt."PassedTrainingCount", 0) AS "ComplianceNumerator",
  COALESCE(pp."TotalPax", 0) AS "TotalPax",
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(pp."TotalPax", 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (COALESCE(ap."ActivePermits", 0) + COALESCE(fm."FitMcuCount", 0) + COALESCE(pt."PassedTrainingCount", 0))::numeric / pp."TotalPax"
  END AS "ComplianceScore"
FROM "sites" s
LEFT JOIN pax_per_site pp ON pp."SiteId" = s."Id"
LEFT JOIN active_permits_per_site ap ON ap."SiteId" = s."Id"
LEFT JOIN fit_mcu_per_site fm ON fm."SiteId" = s."Id"
LEFT JOIN passed_training_per_site pt ON pt."SiteId" = s."Id"
ORDER BY "ComplianceScore" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100;

WITH yearly AS (

    date_part('year', r."ResultDate")::int AS "year",

), ordered AS (
  SELECT
    y."year",
    y."fit_count",
    y."total_count",
    (y."fit_count" / NULLIF(y."total_count", 0)) * 100.0 AS "fit_pct",
    LAG((y."fit_count" / NULLIF(y."total_count", 0)) * 100.0) OVER (ORDER BY y."year") AS "prev_fit_pct"
  FROM yearly y
)
SELECT
  o."year",
  o."fit_pct" AS "fit_percentage",
  o."prev_fit_pct" AS "fit_percentage_prev_year",
  (o."fit_pct" - o."prev_fit_pct") AS "fit_percentage_yoy_change"
FROM ordered o
WHERE o."prev_fit_pct" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY o."year" DESC
LIMIT 100;

WITH dept_counts AS (
  SELECT
    d."Id" AS "DepartmentId",
    d."parent_id" AS "ParentDepartmentId",
    COUNT(*) AS "HeadCount"

SELECT
  dc."DepartmentId" AS "DepartmentId",
  d."Name" AS "DepartmentName",
  dc."ParentDepartmentId" AS "ParentDepartmentId",
  pd."Name" AS "ParentDepartmentName",
  dc."HeadCount" AS "DepartmentHeadCount",
  COALESCE(pc."HeadCount", 0) AS "ParentDepartmentHeadCount"
FROM dept_counts dc
JOIN "departments" d
  ON d."Id" = dc."DepartmentId"
LEFT JOIN "departments" pd
  ON pd."Id" = dc."ParentDepartmentId"
LEFT JOIN dept_counts pc
  ON pc."DepartmentId" = dc."ParentDepartmentId"
WHERE dc."ParentDepartmentId" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY dc."HeadCount" DESC, d."Name" ASC
LIMIT 100;

WITH batch_stats AS (
  SELECT
    it."Id" AS "InductionTypeId",
    it."Name" AS "InductionTypeName",
    ib."Id" AS "BatchId",
    COUNT(DISTINCT ip."Id") AS "TotalParticipants",
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ipm."ExamStatus" = 'PASSED' THEN ipm."Id" END) AS "PassedModuleRows"
  FROM "induction_batches" ib
  JOIN "induction_types" it ON it."Id" = ib."InductionTypeId"
  JOIN "induction_participants" ip ON ip."BatchId" = ib."Id"
  JOIN "induction_participant_modules" ipm ON ipm."InductionParticipantId" = ip."Id"
  JOIN "induction_batch_modules" ibm
    ON ibm."BatchId" = ib."Id"
   AND ibm."ModuleId" = ipm."ModuleId"
   AND ibm."IsDeleted" = false
  WHERE ib."IsDeleted" = false
    AND ip."IsDeleted" = false
    AND ipm."IsDeleted" = false
  GROUP BY it."Id", it."Name", ib."Id"
), batch_completion AS (
  SELECT
    "InductionTypeId",
    "InductionTypeName",
    "BatchId",
    CASE
      WHEN "TotalParticipants" = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE ("PassedModuleRows"::numeric / NULLIF("TotalParticipants", 0))
    END AS "CompletionRate"
  FROM batch_stats
)
SELECT
  "InductionTypeName" AS "InductionType",
  AVG("CompletionRate") AS "AvgCompletionRate"
FROM batch_completion
GROUP BY "InductionTypeName"
ORDER BY (
  SELECT COUNT(*)
  FROM "induction_batches" ib2
  WHERE ib2."IsDeleted" = false
    AND ib2."InductionTypeId" = "InductionTypeId"
) DESC
LIMIT 1;

    p."IssueDate",

  ORDER BY p."IssueDate" ASC
  LIMIT 1

validity_from_oldest AS (
  SELECT
    o."PermitId",
    o."PermitType",
    o."IssueDate",
    o."ExpiryDate",
    (o."ExpiryDate"::date - o."IssueDate"::date) AS "ValidityDays"
  FROM oldest_active o
),
validity_from_document AS (
  SELECT
    pd."PermitId",
    pd."SimExpiryDate"::date AS "SimExpiryDate",
    pd."SimIssuedAt"::date AS "SimIssuedAt",
    (pd."SimExpiryDate"::date - pd."SimIssuedAt"::date) AS "DocumentValidityDays"
  FROM "permit_details" pd
  JOIN oldest_active o ON o."PermitId" = pd."PermitId"
)
SELECT
  vdoc."DocumentValidityDays" AS "DocumentSpecifiedValidityDays",
  vold."ValidityDays" AS "OldestActivePermitValidityDays",
  vold."PermitType" AS "OldestActivePermitType",
  vold."IssueDate" AS "OldestActivePermitIssueDate",
  vold."ExpiryDate" AS "OldestActivePermitExpiryDate"
FROM validity_from_oldest vold
LEFT JOIN validity_from_document vdoc ON vdoc."PermitId" = vold."PermitId"
LIMIT 1;

SELECT "tb"."Id" AS "TrainingBatchId", "tb"."BatchNo", "tb"."SiteId", "tb"."StartDate", "tb"."EndDate", "tb"."MaxParticipants", COUNT("tp"."Id") AS "EnrolledParticipants" 
FROM "training_batches" "tb"
LEFT JOIN "training_participants" "tp" ON "tp"."TrainingBatchId" = "tb"."Id"
GROUP BY "tb"."Id", "tb"."BatchNo", "tb"."SiteId", "tb"."StartDate", "tb"."EndDate", "tb"."MaxParticipants"
HAVING COUNT("tp"."Id") > "tb"."MaxParticipants"
ORDER BY "EnrolledParticipants" DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
  mcu_results."ResultStatus" AS "ResultStatus",
  COUNT(*) AS "ResultCount"
FROM "mcu_results"
JOIN "mcu_registrations" ON "mcu_registrations"."Id" = "mcu_results"."McuRegistrationId"
WHERE "mcu_results"."IsDeleted" = false
  AND "mcu_registrations"."IsDeleted" = false
  AND "mcu_results"."ResultStatus" IN ('UNFIT','FIT')
GROUP BY mcu_results."ResultStatus"
ORDER BY mcu_results."ResultStatus" DESC
LIMIT 100;
